activity.notes: Anne succeeded her father Francis II as ruler of the Duchy of Brittany in 1488 and remained Duchess in her own right until her death on 9 January 1514, even while twice serving as queen of France. ATLAS therefore associates this Activity with her hereditary Duchy of Brittany rather than reducing her to a French queen-consort role.

sources.title: Anne of Brittany, Queen of France — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Anne as Duchess of Brittany and states that she succeeded her father as ruler of the duchy in 1488.

sources.title: Anne de Bretagne : de l'icône au document — Archives départementales du Morbihan
sources.citation_text: The Morbihan departmental archives state that Anne headed the Duchy of Brittany from her father's death in 1488 and died on 9 January 1514.
